name: Dependency Upgrade
description: Check for outdated NPM dependencies, upgrade within the allowed semver scope, and run the test suite to verify compatibility.

package_dir.description: Path to the package directory containing package.json

scope.description: Semver scope for upgrades: patch (x.x.PATCH) or minor (x.MINOR.x)

run_tests.description: If true, run the test suite after upgrading dependencies

steps.description: List all outdated dependencies within the allowed semver scope
Upgrade dependencies to the latest versions within the allowed scope
Run the test suite to verify upgraded dependencies are compatible

constraints: No major version bumps without explicit separate approval
Upgrades are limited to the selected semver scope (patch or minor)
Tests must run and pass after upgrade unless explicitly skipped
invariants: No dependency is upgraded beyond the declared semver scope
package-lock.json is always regenerated after upgrade
A failing test suite blocks the recipe from completing successfully
